section.sectionSummaryBrief: This explains that within all mitzvos, the three categories of eidus, chukim, and mishpatim are interwoven, as even mitzvos with reason have details that are chukah, and even chukim contain an aspect of mishpatim.
section.t: And this will be understood based on what is explained in the aforementioned maamar,
that the three matters of eidus, chukim, and mishpatim are in all mitzvos.
For even the mitzvos of chukim and mishpatim are called by the name eidus
[as it is written,
“He established a testimony in Yaakov,” etc.],
And similarly regarding chukim,
that even in mitzvos that have a reason
(eidus and even mishpatim),
the reason is only for the mitzvah as a whole, not for its details,
and the details are in the manner of “a statute I have decreed, a decree I have issued.”
And similarly regarding mishpatim,
that even in the mitzvos of eidus and chukim there is the aspect of mishpatim.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: In the revelation of G-dliness through mitzvos there are three general levels: the light that permeates worlds, the encompassing light, and the Essence of Ein Sof, each drawn by mishpatim, chukim, and the fact that mitzvos are the will of the Essence, respectively.
section.t: And the concept is,
that in the revelation of G-dliness through the mitzvos there are three general levels.
The light that is enclothed in the worlds,
which in general is the Or HaMimalei (the filling light),
and the light that is above enclothing in the worlds but is related to the worlds,
which in general is the Or HaSovev (the encompassing light),
and the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above any relation to worlds.
For the Or HaMimalei is also grasped by intellect,
and therefore its drawing down is through the aspect of mishpatim,
the comprehension of the intellect.
And the Or HaSovev,
it is not applicable to have positive comprehension of it, only knowledge of negation,
that one knows and understands that in this light it is impossible to have intellectual comprehension,
this is the matter of nullification of comprehension.
And therefore the drawing down of the Or HaSovev is through the fulfillment of chukim,
whose matter is that one nullifies his intellect,
“You have no permission to ponder.”
And regarding the Essence of Ein Sof, which is not in the category of relation to worlds,
it is not applicable to say even that it is negated from intellectual comprehension.
And as explained in Tanya,
that one who says about the Holy One, blessed be He, that He cannot be grasped is like one who says about some lofty and deep wisdom that it cannot be touched with hands,
at which anyone who hears would laugh at him.
For the matter of negation,
that one says about something that it is negated from a second thing,
applies only to things that have a relationship between them,
and intellect and touch are two entirely separate matters that have no relationship between them.
[And perhaps one could add,
that in the analogy of intellect and touch,
since both are created and limited,
there is a relationship between them.
But this is not the case in the analogue.

And therefore, that it is not applicable to say about the Holy One, blessed be He, that He cannot be grasped is even more than it is not applicable to say about an intellectual concept that it cannot be touched with hands].
And therefore,
the drawing down of the Essence of Ein Sof is not even through the matter of chukim,
the nullification of intellect,
because regarding the Essence of Ein Sof it is not applicable to say even the matter of negation of intellect.
And that through the mitzvos there is a drawing down of the Essence of Ein Sof is because the mitzvos are the will and command of the Essence.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The aspect of eidus in all mitzvos is that they draw down and reveal the essential concealment of the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above even the encompassing light, just as testimony in the simple sense applies only to something hidden.
section.t: And this is the matter of eidus in the mitzvos,
that all the mitzvos
(even the mitzvos of chukim and mishpatim)
are called by the name eidus because they draw down and reveal the essential concealment of the Essence of Ein Sof,
which is above even the Sovev.
For just as the matter of testimony in the simple sense is specifically about something hidden,
for regarding something revealed, testimony does not apply,
since it is revealed,
and even regarding something that is destined to be revealed, testimony is not needed,
so too is it in the spiritual sense,
that the Or HaMimalei is a revealed thing that is grasped by intellect,
and the Or HaSovev, which is above enclothing in the worlds, is a matter destined to be revealed
(a concealment that is related to revelation),
for through the comprehension of the Or HaMimalei that is enclothed in the worlds,
which is only a radiation
(as is proven from this very fact that it is in enclothing),
one comes to the knowledge that there is a light that is wondrously beyond worlds,
which is the source from which the radiation in enclothing is drawn.
And the matter of eidus is regarding the Essence of Ein Sof,
which is above even the Sovev,
which is completely hidden.
And this is why all the mitzvos are called eidus,
because they draw down and reveal the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above even the Sovev.
